newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down, but off intra-day low.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down, but off intra-day low.

text.p: The Shanghai B share index continued to fall on Friday but ended off its intra-day low of 62.352 points with strong support at low levels, brokers said.
The index fell 0.600 points or 0.93 percent to 63.743 points, on volume of 25.0 million shares worth $12.1 million. All 42 B shares traded, with 21 down, six flat and 15 up.
Brokers said the market reversed early losses on bargain-hunting buying in the afternoon.
The index is still consolidating in a range of 63-65 points, they said.
"If there is no fresh market-moving news, the market will rally again next week as few investors are willing to sell B shares any more at current cheap levels," one broker said.
"Technical charts also indicate a rebound will come," he added.
Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass was the biggest loser on expectation of unpromising results, falling $0.044 or 9.28 percent to $0.430, on volume of 363,000 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development traded the most on institutional liquidation, down $0.022 or 1.80 percent to $1.200, on volume of 3.5 million shares.
Shanghai A share fell on weak sentiment after Beijing's crackdown with a wait-and-see mood dominating the market, brokers said.
The index closed down 18.208 points 1.94 percent to 922.340 points, on volume of 556.2 million shares worth 4.8 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index bucked the market on institutional support, rising 11.937 points or 0.50 percent to 2405.747 points.
